'''Vaal Hall''' was a government building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sus'mintri]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] isolated continent of [[Alanciar]]. Named after celebrated Alanciari figure [[Adari Vaal]], Vaal Hall contained [[Library of Adari Vaal|Adari Vaal's secret library]].
